note: No fact: the completion report (December 2019; capture truncated before the outcome section on the EMIS, so its results and any school counts are not held) describes the EMIS/SIGE as a management information system for the ministry, with a computer per primary school 'for data management' and an online link to DPEI, and calls it 'newly established' by 2019. It nowhere says schools enter per-learner records, nor that the return is yearly, so the class is left empty. It also states that at appraisal in 2012 there was no reliable EMIS linking the ministry with decentralised structures, though education statistics were regularly published; it does not say how schools kept learner records.
